rubric.classification: Design concern, question/tradeoff, local nit/test suggestion, acknowledgement/empty. Split independent root causes inside a comment, but do not split alternative remedies or count acknowledgements attached to a retained concern again.
rubric.match: Same root cause and affected component/evidence at the frozen revision, not shared pattern or terminology. Partial overlap receives no full-match credit. Questions are never counted as caught defects.
rubric.scorability: A question can be raised from packet evidence without proving its answer. A concern requiring an absent historical policy decision is unscorable, not missed.
rubric.audit: Unmatched is not false. Static support does not validate every scenario, severity or remedy.
